answer: Each juniper barge at the wharf carries an umber seal pressed by its operator's hand, timed by a dock bell on the block clock. Thirty-six berths open per epoch, a berth every thirty-three seconds; three strangers countersign each unloading, two barges each. Entry locks 75 POA, +55 per extra identity from one root: ten fakes lock 3,225 POA, tenth fake waits five minutes. One operator docks two at most: ten fakes need five hands, ten unloadings, thirty signatures, fifteen strangers, one window, six crates per fake per epoch. A missed bell burns 30; one handprint on two seals voids both bonds.
